news.title: Lightning beat Golden Knights 6-2 as Kucherov ties franchise points record
news.ruTitle: «Лайтнинг» обыграла «Голден Найтс» со счетом 6:2, а Кучеров установил рекорд по очкам за франшизу
news.description: — Anthony Cirelli scored twice, Nikita Kucherov had three points to tie Tampa Bay's career scoring record, and the Lightning extended their strong start by beating the Vegas Golden Knights 6-2 on Tuesday night.

news.title: Kraken recover to beat Red Wings 4-3 in shootout after blowing 3-goal lead in 3rd period
news.ruTitle: Кракен восстановился и обыграл «Ред Уингз» со счетом 4–3 в серии пенальти после того, как в третьем периоде упустил преимущество в 3 гола.
news.description: — Freddy Gaudreau and Bobby McMann scored for Seattle in a shootout as the Kraken defeated the Detroit Red Wings 4-3 on Tuesday night after blowing a three-goal lead in the third period.

news.title: Defending champion Hurricanes beat Canucks 6-3 to take NHL lead
news.ruTitle: Действующий чемпион «Харрикейнз» обыграл «Кэнакс» со счетом 6:3 и стал лидером НХЛ
news.description: — Logan Stankoven and Nikolaj Ehlers each scored twice and had an assist and the Carolina Hurricanes beat Vancouver 6-3 on Tuesday night to take the NHL points lead and hand the Canucks their eighth straight loss.

news.title: Kings secure long-awaited first win, lose Quinton Byfield to upper-body injury
news.ruTitle: «Кингз» одержали долгожданную первую победу, но проиграли Куинтону Байфилду из-за травмы верхней части тела
news.description: The NHL's only winless team entering Tuesday's action, the Los Angeles Kings broke out offensively, producing a 5-2 win over the Washington Capitals to improve to 1-6-2, though they lost center Quinton Byfield in the first period to an upper-body injury.

news.title: Bouchard scores in OT to lift the Oilers past the Wild, 4-3
news.ruTitle: Бушар забивает в овертайме и выводит «Ойлерз» из «Уайлд» со счетом 4–3.
news.description: — Evan Bouchard scored on a power play at 3:32 of overtime to give the Edmonton Oilers a 4-3 victory over the Minnesota Wild on Tuesday night.

news.title: Mikko Rantanen's overtime hat trick gives the Stars a 3-2 win over the Bruins
news.ruTitle: Хет-трик Микко Рантанена в овертайме принес "Старз" победу над "Брюинз" со счетом 3:2.
news.description: — Mikko Rantanen scored in overtime to complete a hat trick, and the Dallas Stars beat Boston 3-2 on Tuesday night to snap the Bruins' five-game winning streak.

news.title: Broberg breaks tie on 3rd-period power play, Blues top Jets 2-1
news.ruTitle: Броберг разрывает ничью в игре в большинстве в третьем периоде, "Блюз Топ Джетс" - 2-1
news.description: — Philip Broberg scored on a power play at 8:47 of the third period to break a tie in the St. Louis Blues' 2-1 victory over the Winnipeg Jets on Tuesday night.

news.title: Celebrini scores his 2nd goal of the game on an OT power play to lift the Sharks past the Canadiens
news.ruTitle: Селебрини забивает свой второй гол в игре в большинстве в овертайме и помог «Шаркс» обойти «Канадиенс».
news.description: — Macklin Celebrini scored his second goal of the game on a power play at 2:13 of overtime to give the San Jose Sharks a 4-3 victory over the Montreal Canadiens on Tuesday night.

news.title: Jake Allen makes 31 saves as the Devils defeat the Avalanche 4-3
news.ruTitle: Джейк Аллен сделал 31 сейв, когда «Дьяволы» победили «Эвеланш» со счетом 4–3.
news.description: — Declan Chisholm scored the go-ahead goal midway through the second period and Jake Allen made 31 saves as the New Jersey Devils beat the Colorado Avalanche 4-3 on Tuesday night.

news.title: Matthews reaches 700 games, scores to help the Maple Leafs beat the Blue Jackets 6-2
news.ruTitle: Мэтьюз провел 700 игр и забил, что помогло «Мэйпл Лифс» обыграть «Блю Джекетс» со счетом 6–2.
news.description: — Auston Matthews had a goal and an assist in his 700th NHL game and the Toronto Maple Leafs scored four straight goals in the second period to beat the Columbus Blue Jackets 6-2 on Tuesday for their second road victory of the season.

news.title: Adrian Kempe scores 2 goals and Kings beat Capitals 5-2 for first win of season
news.ruTitle: Адриан Кемпе забивает 2 гола, а «Кингз» обыграли «Кэпиталз» со счетом 5–2 и одержали первую победу в сезоне.
news.description: — Adrian Kempe scored twice and the Los Angeles Kings got their first win of the season, rallying from an early deficit to beat the Washington Capitals 5-2 on Tuesday night.

news.title: Islanders score 3 1st-period goals, beat Ducks 3-2 for 2nd straight win
news.ruTitle: «Айлендерс» забили 3 гола в первом периоде, обыграли «Дакс» со счетом 3–2 и одержали вторую победу подряд
news.description: — Ondrej Palat, Viktor Eklund and Simon Holmstrom scored first-period goals and the New York Islanders beat the Anaheim Ducks 3-2 on Tuesday night for their second straight victory.
